The '''Divis Arm''' was a region of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] which contained the [[Pirik system/Legends|Pirik system]] and that later became a subsector of the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]. It was known for the large amount of [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] activity.
